Message.Name: Time Reference Message
Message.Description: The Time Reference message is used to provide a midnight reference point for recipients of the feed. It is sent whenever the system starts up and when the system crosses a midnight boundary. All subsequent Time messages for the same unit will the use the last Midnight Reference until another Time Reference message is received for that unit.

Field.Name: Midnight Reference
Field.Description: Midnight Central Time reference time for subsequent Time messages, expressed as number of whole seconds since the Epoch (Midnight January 1, 1970 UTC).

Field.Name: Time Reference
Field.Description: Number of whole seconds from midnight Central Time.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Trade Date
Field.Description: Current Trade Date

Message.Name: Time Message
Message.Description: A Time message is sent whenever the source time for a unit passes over a second boundary.

Field.Name: Time Reference
Field.Description: Number of whole seconds from midnight Eastern Time

Field.Name: Epoch
Field.Description: Number of whole seconds Since Epoch: 1.1.1970

Message.Name: Unit Clear Message
Message.Description: The Unit Clear message instructs feed recipients to clear all orders for the Cboe book in the unit specified in the Sequenced Unit Header. This message will be sent at startup each day.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Message.Name: Futures Instrument Definition Message
Message.Description: The Unit Clear message instructs feed recipients to clear all orders for the Cboe book in the unit specified in the Sequenced Unit Header. This message will be sent at startup each day.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp or Unit Timestamp in this message if it is non-zero.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Six character, base 62 symbol.

Field.Name: Unit Timestamp
Field.Description: Unit timestamp expressed as number of whole seconds since the Epoch (Midnight, January 1, 1970 UTC).

Field.Name: Report Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol for product or underlying security.

Field.Name: Futures Flags
Field.Description: Bit 0 – Variance (1: Variance Future, 0: Standard Future)

Field.Name: Expiration Date
Field.Description: Expiration Date of Instrument.

Field.Name: Contract Size
Field.Description: Contract size of Instrument.

Field.Name: Listing State
Field.Description: A = Active , I = Inactive, T = Test

Field.Name: Price Increment
Field.Description: Minimum Price Increment

Field.Name: Leg Count
Field.Description: Values greater than 0 indicate this is a spread instrument.

Field.Name: Leg Offset
Field.Description: Leg definitions, if any, begin at this offset from the beginning of the message. Possible values are 0 (no legs present) or 41 (spread instrument).

Field.Name: Variance Block Offset
Field.Description: Variance Future parameter block begins at this offset from the beginning of the message. Possible values are 0 (no Variance Block) or 41 (Variance Block present).

Field.Name: Future Block
Field.Description: Future struct

Message.Name: Add Order Long Message
Message.Description: An Add Order message represents a newly accepted visible order on the Cboe book.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Day-specific identifier assigned to this order

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: B = Buy Order S = Sell Order

Field.Name: Long Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts being added to the book (may be less than the number entered).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Long Price
Field.Description: The limit order price

Message.Name: Add Order Short Message
Message.Description: An Add Order message represents a newly accepted visible order on the Cboe book.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Day-specific identifier assigned to this order

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: B = Buy Order S = Sell Order

Field.Name: Short Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts being added to the book (may be less than the number entered).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Short Price
Field.Description: The limit order price

Message.Name: Order Executed Message
Message.Description: Order Executed messages are sent when a visible order on the Cfe book is executed in whole or in part.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that was executed

Field.Name: Executed Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts executed

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this execution. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Options Only (byte not sent in Equities) (Space): Normal Trade S: Spread trade

Message.Name: Reduce Size Long Message
Message.Description: Reduce Size messages are sent when a visible order on the Cboe book is partially reduced.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been reduced

Field.Name: Canceled Long Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts canceled

Message.Name: Reduce Size Short Message
Message.Description: Reduce Size messages are sent when a visible order on the Cboe book is partially reduced.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been reduced

Field.Name: Canceled Short Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts canceled

Message.Name: Modify Order Long Message
Message.Description: The Modify Order message is sent whenever an open order is visibly modified. The Order Id refers to the Order Id of the original Add Order message.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been modified

Field.Name: Long Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts associated with this order after this modify (may be less than the number entered)

Field.Name: Long Price
Field.Description: The limit order price after this modify

Message.Name: Modify Order Short Message
Message.Description: The Modify Order message is sent whenever an open order is visibly modified. The Order Id refers to the Order Id of the original Add Order message.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been modified

Field.Name: Short Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts associated with this order after this modify (may be less than the number entered)

Field.Name: Short Price
Field.Description: The limit order price after this modify

Message.Name: Delete Order Message
Message.Description: The Delete Order message is sent whenever an open order is completely canceled. The Order Id refers to the Order Id of the original Add Order message.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has completely cancelled

Message.Name: Trade Long Message
Message.Description: The Trade message provides information about executions of non-displayed orders on the Cboe book and routed executions to other trading centers.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Obfuscated Order ID or Order Id of the executed order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Always B = Buy Order regardless of resting side

Field.Name: Long Quantity
Field.Description: Incremental number of shares/contracts executed

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Long Price
Field.Description: The execution price of the order

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this trade. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message.

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Trade Condition Enum

Message.Name: Trade Short Message
Message.Description: The Trade message provides information about executions of non-displayed orders on the Cboe book and routed executions to other trading centers.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Obfuscated Order ID or Order Id of the executed order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Always B = Buy Order regardless of resting side

Field.Name: Short Quantity
Field.Description: Incremental number of shares/contracts executed

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Short Price
Field.Description: The execution price of the order

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this trade. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message.

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Trade Condition Value

Message.Name: Transaction Begin
Message.Description: The Transaction Begin message indicates any subsequent messages, up to the accompanying Transaction End message, are all part of the same transaction block.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Message.Name: Transaction End
Message.Description: The Transaction End message indicates that a transaction indicated by a previous Transaction Begin message has completed.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Message.Name: Trade Break Message
Message.Description: The Trade Break message is sent whenever an execution on Cfe is broken.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe execution identifier of the execution that was broken. Execution Id refers to previously sent Order Executed or Trade message.

Message.Name: Settlement Message
Message.Description: Settlement messages are normally sent once per day per instrument after settlement prices have been calculated for all applicable instruments on a given business date.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Six character, base 62 symbol.

Field.Name: Trade Date
Field.Description: Trade Date for the settlement.

Field.Name: Settlement Price
Field.Description: Settlement Price

Field.Name: Issue
Field.Description: S = Initial Settlement, R = Re-issued Settlement

Message.Name: End Of Day Summary Message
Message.Description: The End of Day Summary is sent out right after trading ends for a symbol. No more Market Update messages will follow an End of Day Summary for a particular symbol.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Six character, base 62 symbol.

Field.Name: Trade Date
Field.Description: Trade Date for the message.

Field.Name: Open Interest
Field.Description: Prior Trade Date Open Interest for this symbol.

Field.Name: High Price
Field.Description: The higher of highest bid price and highest trade price for the day. Block and ECRP trades (Trade Condition = B or E) do not update High Price.

Field.Name: Low Price
Field.Description: The lower of lowest offer price and lowest trade price for the day. Block and ECRP trades (Trade Condition = B or E) do not update Low Price.

Field.Name: Open Price
Field.Description: The first trade on the day (in any session) will set the Open Price for the day (valid only if Total Volume > 0). Block and ECRP trades (Trade Condition = B or E) do not update Open Price.

Field.Name: Close Price
Field.Description: The last trade on the day (in any session) will set the Close Price for the day (valid only if Total Volume > 0). Block and ECRP trades (Trade Condition = B or E) do not update Close Price.

Field.Name: Total Volume
Field.Description: Total number of contracts traded for the day, including block and ECRP trades.

Field.Name: Block Volume
Field.Description: Total number of block contracts traded for the day.

Field.Name: ECRP Volume
Field.Description: Total number of contracts traded for the day.

Field.Name: Summary Flags
Field.Description: Summary Flags

Message.Name: Trading Status Message
Message.Description: The Trading Status message is used to indicate the current trading status of a security. A Trading Status message will be sent whenever a security's trading status changes.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Six character, base 62 symbol.

Field.Name: Reserved2
Field.Description: Reserved

Field.Name: Trading Status
Field.Description: Trading Status Values

Field.Name: Reserved3
Field.Description: Reserved

Message.Name: End of Session Message
Message.Description: The End of Session message is sent for each unit when the unit shuts down. No more sequenced messages will be delivered for this unit, but heartbeats from the unit may be received.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Future Leg
Field.Description: Number of whole seconds from midnight Eastern Time

Field.Name: Realized Variance
Field.Description: Realized Variance to date (signed 64-bit decimal with 8 implied decimal places)

Field.Name: Num Expected Prices
Field.Description: Number of expected SP500 prices to be used for calculating returns during the life of the contract

Field.Name: Num Elapsed Returns
Field.Description: Number of returns elapsed as of the beginning of the trading day

Field.Name: Previous Settlement
Field.Description: Previous day Settlement Value

Field.Name: Discount Factor
Field.Description: Discount Factor (signed 64-bit decimal with 16 implied decimal places)

Field.Name: Initial Strike
Field.Description: Initial strike

Field.Name: Previous ARMVM
Field.Description: ARMVM that was used to adjust the previous day settlement price (signed 64-bit decimal value with 6 implied decimal places)

Field.Name: Fed Funds Rate
Field.Description: Fed Funds rate of prior day (signed 64-bit number with 6 implied decimal places)

Field.Name: Future Leg
Field.Description: Future leg group

Field.Name: Leg Ratio
Field.Description: Leg ratio (positive for bid-side, negative for ask-side)

Field.Name: Leg Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol of leg.

Field.Name: High Price Valid
Field.Description: Set if high price valid value

Field.Name: High Price Is Bid
Field.Description: Set if high price was set by the highest bid

Field.Name: Low Price Valid
Field.Description: Set if low price is a valid value

Field.Name: Low Price Is Offer
Field.Description: Set if low price was set by the lowest offer

Field.Name: Offer Close Valid
Field.Description: Set if open price and close price contain valid values

Field.Name: Reserved Flags
Field.Description: Reserved 5-7 Bits
